```python
def _get_word_tokens(self, word: str) -> List[str]:
    """
    Convert word to list of characters with end-of-word marker.
    """
    if not word:
        return []

    tokens = list(word)
    tokens[-1] += Tokenizer.TOK_EOW  # Mark end of word
    return tokens
```
